title: Alerts and escalation
subtitle: Who is notified, and after how long, when a dose is late or the loved one asks for help.
enabledHint: Disabled: a late dose triggers nothing more and “I need help” notifies the whole circle, as before.

medication.title: Late medication
medication.patient: Remind the loved one on the patient screen after
medication.off: Set 0 to disable a step. After four hours the dose is marked missed and the escalation stops.

help.title: “I need help” button
help.immediate: The primary caregivers are notified immediately.
help.ack: If nobody takes charge (“I am on it” on the dashboard), notify the backup caregivers after
